analyzed_vuln.description: The fU0 execution path incorrectly gates handling of virtual channel qualifiers with `(int) pel->ChannelQual < 0`. FX virtual channels are actually defined as positive out-of-range PixelChannel values (`INTENSITY_CHANNEL` is `MaxPixelChannels+7`). Consequently `u.intensity` skips the intended `GetIntensity()` branch and falls through to `pimg->channel_map[WHICH_NON_ATTR_CHAN].offset`; `WHICH_NON_ATTR_CHAN` resolves to the virtual value, indexing channel_map at MaxPixelChannels+7 even though AcquirePixelChannelMap allocates only MaxPixelChannels+1 entries. This causes the heap-buffer-overflow read at ExecuteRPN line 3652/3653. The same erroneous virtual-channel dispatch pattern appears in neighboring image-access cases and should be corrected using explicit virtual-channel recognition rather than a sign test.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Attacker-controlled LABEL text must contain a braced property expansion that enters the hex FX evaluator with an image-access expression using the intensity virtual qualifier, as in `%[hex:u.intensity]`. ReadLABELImage passes this text to InterpretImageProperties; the `hex:` handler compiles `u.intensity`, and the implicit zero argument for `u` is optimized to fU0. FxEvaluateChannelExpression then evaluates it at (0,0); the positive INTENSITY_CHANNEL qualifier bypasses the virtual-channel branch and is used as an invalid channel_map index, producing the out-of-bounds read. A normal property image with an allocated pixel channel map is sufficient; no special dimensions or pixel contents are required.

What virtual qualifiers can ChannelQual contain, how should each be handled, and what is the safest minimal root-cause patch that prevents indexing Image::channel_map with an out-of-range PixelChannel while preserving FX behavior?

The provided ASan reproducer is LABEL data `%[hex:u.intensity]`. InterpretImageProperties compiles `u.intensity`; the implicit zero argument selects the optimized fU0 ExecuteRPN path. INTENSITY_CHANNEL is reportedly a positive virtual PixelChannel value, MaxPixelChannels+7, but the current code only enters virtual handling when `(int) pel->ChannelQual < 0`; it therefore indexes `pimg->channel_map[WHICH_NON_ATTR_CHAN].offset` out of bounds around fx.c:3652. The report says neighboring image-access cases repeat this erroneous dispatch, so the patch should comprehensively fix all analogous ExecuteRPN branches rather than special-case only fU0.
